arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Conjurations{/c} are empowered and deal {c_random}[SF_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage but each one drains {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} Mana per second.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Ice Blades{/c} attacks burst in an area around the target.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Lightning Spear{/c} hits have a {c_number}[SF_7 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to spawn static {c_important}Ball Lightnings{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Familiar{/c} leaves damaging ground after its attack.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Hydra{/c} periodically creates {c_important}Firewalls{/c} towards its target.
